international.summary: The former Liberal MP had fought a long battle against glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer Former Liberal MP Sharman Stone has died via voluntary assisted dying after spending much of her political career advocating that people should have autonomy over their bodies. Dr Stone died aged 75 on Wednesday surrounded by family after a long fight against glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer. Continue reading...
